title: Task preparation cannot publish directories on WSL when no-replace rename is unsupported
outcome: Task preparation cannot publish directories on WSL when no-replace rename is unsupported
acceptance: Task preparation and the existing task_prepared regression suite succeed on the WSL repository filesystem without hard-linking directories, skipping tests, or loosening their assertions.
Directory publication preserves the no-overwrite contract and existing destination bytes on collision or interruption, with Windows and Linux coverage.
